description: This file defines the interface for the L2testController class, including singleton management, process control methods (StartThunder, StopThunder), and a test execution method (PerformL2Tests) with JSON parameter handling.

classes.name: L2testController
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for controlling L2 tests, managing processes, and executing test methods within a WPEFramework environment.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of L2testController.

methods.name: StartThunder
methods.description: Initiates the Thunder process in an isolated environment.

methods.name: PerformL2Tests
methods.description: Executes an L2 test by invoking the first method of the L2Tests plugin with given parameters and captures the results.
